1044287a-73df-48d0-b0b2-5327f32dd651.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Part 7 - Steel Ball Run Color-ban
1044287a-73df-48d0-b0b2-5327f32dd651.altTitle: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run - Digital Colored Comics
1044287a-73df-48d0-b0b2-5327f32dd651.description: In the American Old West, the world's greatest race is about to begin. Thousands line up in San Diego to travel over six thousand kilometers for a chance to win the grand prize of fifty million dollars. With the era of the horse reaching its end, contestants are allowed to use any kind of vehicle they wish. Competitors will have to endure grueling conditions, traveling up to a hundred kilometers a day through uncharted wastelands. The Steel Ball Run is truly a one-of-a-kind event.  The youthful Johnny Joestar, a crippled former horse racer, has come to San Diego to watch the start of the race. There he encounters Gyro Zeppeli, a racer with two steel balls at his waist instead of a gun. Johnny witnesses Gyro using one of his steel balls to unleash a fantastical power, compelling a man to fire his gun at himself during a duel. In the midst of the action, Johnny happens to touch the steel ball and feels a power surging through his legs, allowing him to stand up for the first time in two years. Vowing to find the secret of the steel balls, Johnny decides to compete in the race, and so begins his bizarre adventure across America on the Steel Ball Run.

6a769300-091e-49ab-8cd3-cc32c360ecc0.description:
A man suddenly found himself standing alone on a mountain filled with plants and creatures he'd never seen before. Transported to another world with nothing but the clothes on his back, he wasn’t granted any convenient otherworldly bonuses. His wish isn't to become a hero or to build a harem, but simply to “live safely”. This is the story of a man who survives in another world using only his Comprehension as his weapon!

c8a0426d-539b-4f6a-9537-fbccf4962529.title: Amayo no Tsuki
c8a0426d-539b-4f6a-9537-fbccf4962529.altTitle: The Moon on a Rainy Night
c8a0426d-539b-4f6a-9537-fbccf4962529.description: One rainy night, Saki is rushing to a piano lesson when she crashes into a beautiful, long-haired girl, dropping her sheet music in the process. Saki stutters an apology, but the girl simply hands back her sheet music and leaves without a word. Saki begins her first day of high school the following morning, only to find the stranger from the night before sitting at the desk next to hers. She learns that the girl's name is Kanon and that she is not quite completely deaf, but very hard of hearing. Though Kanon needs to be close to people to read their lips, she tends to push people away with her icy demeanor. Through one kind gesture, Saki slowly begins breaking down the walls around Kanon, even as she feels something new blossoming within her.

6655cece-57c8-4188-a04d-a9aa0903abb9.title: Captain Tsubasa: Rising Sun - FINALS
6655cece-57c8-4188-a04d-a9aa0903abb9.description:
A web-comic continuation of Captain Tsubasa 9th arc: Rising Sun - The Final.

Rising Sun - FINALS is covering the 2nd half of the Madrid Olympics match of Japan VS. Spain and beyond.

The web-comic came to be when on April 2024 mangaka Yoichi Takahashi announced his retirement, ending Rising Sun - The Final official published serialization half-way through the match opting to continue the story at his own pace with storyboard pencil sketches, publishing them on the official Captain Tsubasa World website.

0f45068f-9681-42da-9ca2-d80fd7998b25.title: Choegang ui Romanticist
0f45068f-9681-42da-9ca2-d80fd7998b25.description:
Ryu Woo-jin, the undisputed top dog at Dupal High School—the worst high school in the country.
No one can beat him in a fight, but in reality, he’s a romance genre fanatic and an aspiring webtoon author.

Determined to find true romance, Ryu Woo-jin decides to transfer to an ordinary co-ed school.

Will he be able to find sweet romantic material at his new school and create a proper masterpiece?

beb4a784-c30c-4a56-9165-a9adefbc422e.description: Before Hanaki Guriko reluctantly reigned supreme over Toarushi, he lived in Fukuoka. This is the story about his time kicking ass and taking names in middle school there.

c81272a7-9e4e-42f3-99ba-732eb7617a04.title: Maou to Yuusha ga Jidai Okure ni Narimashita
c81272a7-9e4e-42f3-99ba-732eb7617a04.altTitle: The Demon King and the Hero Became Out of Time
c81272a7-9e4e-42f3-99ba-732eb7617a04.description: A young guy named Igusa, obsessed with all things “evil,” gets reincarnated as the “Demon Lord” he always admired—only to end up in a seriously rough situation. The new world he’s reborn into has been wrecked by an interstellar war, leaving both swords and magic in decline! He finally becomes the Demon Lord, but the planet he was supposed to conquer? Yeah, it’s already on the verge of collapse… That’s when a girl calling herself a “Hero” and a beast-eared girl from another world show up. Without hesitation, Igusa forces them into his ranks, grinning like a true villain. —No land left to conquer? No problem. He’ll just take over the entire universe! A dark fantasy filled with interstellar intrigue, where Igusa and his fated companions charge forward in pursuit of “evil!

2b5b045c-32ee-4f3e-85cc-8f205000ec98.title: Your Reason for Living
2b5b045c-32ee-4f3e-85cc-8f205000ec98.description:
"Congratulations on being born."

Once I opened my eyes, I was in a cold laboratory. I wasn't born because I wasn't human, I was created, but she still celebrates it nevertheless. 

I learned how to live by drinking coffee together, smelling the scent, hearing the sound of decoration shaking due to the wind, and becoming close to the rabbit who often came to visit the garden. 

However...

"Actually, in a week from now, I'm going to die."

She, who neither complains about pain or reveals her pain, is calm, but why does my heart hurt so much? I was also a person who could shed tears. 

"Why did you create me? Why did you make me like you?"
